verdict.rationale: Metorial is a SaaS platform that brokers agent access to user data, so a no-training or data-use policy is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no statement about training opt-outs, data-use policies, or model-training exclusions. Access controls, RBAC/SSO, and per-user OAuth are adjacent security features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
